name: Sticky Reviews – turn client feedback into trust on every page
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Keep your best client reviews visible on every page – displayed professionally in your site footer – so visitors see social proof wherever they scroll.

Why Sticky Reviews?

Testimonials buried on a single page rarely get seen. Sticky Reviews showcases your clients’ and customers’ reviews and feedback in the site footer in a professional way, so social proof follows visitors as they browse.

The plugin is very easy to use: add your reviews once, configure the display, and they appear site-wide – a simple, effective way to build trust and attract more customers.

Free Features

  • Sticky Footer Display: Show client reviews and feedback in the site footer on every page.
  • Left or Right Position: Display the review box on the left or right side of the screen.
  • Simple Configuration: Manage everything from a single settings page in your dashboard.
  • Easy to Use: Input your review data, configure the options, and you’re done.

How to Use – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the Sticky Reviews plugin.
  2. In your dashboard, go to Sticky Reviews → Sticky Reviews Options.
  3. Input your review data in the necessary fields and configure the display.
  4. Save – your reviews now appear in the site footer. Enjoy!

Use Cases

  • Service businesses: Keep glowing client feedback in front of prospective customers.
  • Online stores: Reinforce buying decisions with customer reviews on every page.
  • Freelancers & agencies: Display testimonials site-wide without redesigning pages.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Sticky Reviews”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Sticky Reviews → Sticky Reviews Options to add your reviews.

Manual installation:

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your reviews under Sticky Reviews → Sticky Reviews Options.
sections.faq:
Is Sticky Reviews free?

Yes, Sticky Reviews is a free WordPress plugin.

Where do the reviews appear on my site?

Reviews are displayed in your site’s footer area as a sticky element, so they stay visible while visitors browse.

Can I choose which side the reviews appear on?

Yes. The reviews can be displayed on the left or the right side, as shown in the plugin screenshots.

How do I add and configure my reviews?

Go to Sticky Reviews → Sticky Reviews Options in your dashboard, input your data in the necessary fields, and configure the display settings.
